name: Potamosia
account: A democracy. Decisions are made by a simple majority of all the citizens present. By custom the mayors speak first. Mayors are elected every year and can be removed by a majority vote. Two citizens chosen by lot chair each meeting: they give and take away the right to speak, draft resolutions and call votes. Votes are by a show of hands.

name: Hudrosia
account: An oligarchy. A council of the city’s elite decides, led by two hereditary kings, while the rest of the city looks on. In principle the council decides by consensus; in practice, by a majority in a secret council vote.
